notes.title: It's You: A Dev Story (Live Stream)
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been quite a while since this game was released, which means we've had quite a while to reflect on how we made it and why. Traci and Brook, two of the main writers on the project, will be playing the game live tomorrow (Sunday June 28th) at 1 PM PST/4 PM EST and discussing some of our inspirations, reservations, and what we think this is all about.

Laughs? Tears? We'll see. We will also be reviewing how the game was received by players.

The stream will be visible on our Steam Store Page or on Twitch at Scenario World (https://twitch.tv/scenarioworld).

notes.title: Valentine's Sale! And More...
notes.notes:
Give It's You: A Break Up Story the second chance your boyfriend doesn't deserve.

For Valentine's Day, It's You: A Breakup Story is 50% off on Steam. Whether it's for yourself, your friend, or someone who really needs to understand why they are [i]not[/i] your friend anymore, this holiday is the perfect time to spread the joy of just how shitty it can be dating some of the guys out there today.

As always, 20% of the proceeds from the game will be donated to Atira Women's Resource Society in British Columbia.

Feel like you haven't heard enough from your favourite ex-boyfriend? Check out our new website: [url=http://download.brwarner.net/josh/]Did He Say [i]That?[/i][/url] where you can browse and relive the many hours of voice acting from the talented Jacob Burgess that went into the game.

And, if you'd care to see behind the scenes, we've posted the scripts written in Inkle's Ink story language on [url=https://github.com/brwarner/breakup-ink]GitHub[/url].

Hope you have a wonderful Valentine's or, if you're not, that this game gives you a little something interesting to do with that misery,
The Breakup Story Team
